semantics.matches: byte-exact, case-sensitive, non-overlapping, leftmost; spans are global file offsets; line numbers are 1-based
semantics.literal: 1..path_max_utf8_bytes bytes of valid UTF-8; a literal containing a newline is Unsupported; regex metacharacters are plain bytes
semantics.chunking: chunk_bytes new bytes per window plus literal.len - 1 bytes carried from the previous window; matches starting before the end of the previous match are dropped
semantics.skips: NUL byte -> binary; invalid UTF-8 anywhere (validated across chunk boundaries) -> invalid_utf8; size > max_file_bytes -> oversize; open failure -> open_failed; all counted in Coverage.skipped
semantics.context: windows [line - c, line + c] that overlap or touch are merged; each line is returned once; context_lines <= 20
semantics.consistency: checked_live only (other modes Unsupported); after projection size, mtime, identity and path identity are rechecked and every match's literal bytes are checked in the re-read text; a changed file is retried once and then skipped; lines from two versions are never combined
semantics.caps: limit counts matches across files; output budget counts context text bytes; either cap ends the search with truncated = true; Searcher.output_bytes lowers the budget per call
semantics.cancellation: checked per candidate file and per scanned chunk
semantics.timing: Report.first_match_ns (first match found by the scan) and first_push_ns (first result delivered to the sink) are separate
semantics.candidates: one traversal limited to max_file_results (10,000) files; glob, hidden and ignore rules from T05 apply
semantics.allocation: Searcher.init allocates every buffer; search allocates nothing

exports: zcr_search (src/search/literal.zig): Caps{defaultBytes}, SearchFault{after_scan, after_chunk}, Report{searchSkipped}, Searcher{init, deinit, report, search (core.SearchLiteralFn), readAt, output_bytes, fault}
zcr_search.context: FileMatch, Interval, buildIntervals, Projection, project, max_context_lines
limitations: scalar kernel only; SIMD kernels are T19 and must reproduce scalar.find spans
case-insensitive search and regex are not implemented
more than 10,000 candidate files are reported as truncated by the traversal, not searched
a deadline is expressed only through Cancel; SearchSpec has no deadline field
a same-size rewrite that restores mtime and keeps the literal bytes at every match position is not detected
Linux and Intel macOS are cross-compiled only
